FULL TEXT:
HIGH CDURT OF GUJAR.AT AT AHMEDABAD
NOTICE
No. C.0305/2026/01
Date: of I07/2026
Re : Notice inviting applications for designation
Advocate, for the High Court of Gujarat.
of Senior
Applications are invited under the High Court of Gujarat (Designation of
Senior Advocates) Rules, 2025 (Amended as on 14.05.2026) ("the Rules,
2025"), from the eligible Advocates desirous of being designated as Senior
Advocates by the High Court of Gujarat.
In terms of Rule 9 of the Rules, 2025, if the application of an Advocate for
designation as a Senior Advocate has not been favourably considered by
the Full Court, such Advocate shall not be allowed to make a fresh
application for a period of 2 (two) years from the date of the decision of the
Full Court. After the expiry of the said period, the Advocate may submit a
fresh application for reconsideration in accordance with the Rules, 2025.
The applicant shall ensure compliance with the following requirements
prescribed under the Rules of 2025 :
l.The applicant shall submit an 'Application cum Consent Letter' as
given in Schedule-I appended to the aforesaid Rules along with all
relevant documents and shall also fill details in the prescribed
formats attached with the Schedule-I. The application shall he
addressed to Hon'ble the Chief Justice of the High Court of Gujarat.
2. Applicant shall strictly comply with the general instructions given in
the Rules while filling up 'Application cum Consent Letter' appended
to Schedule-I.
3. Every application shall be endorsed by two designated Senior
Advocates having standing of not less than ten years as a Senior
Advocate of the High Court of Gujarat, as required under Rule 4(vii)
of the Rules, 2025.
//1//
4.An applicant practicing before the High Court of Gujarat shall
submit fifty (50) reported/unreported judgments of the last five years
in which he/ she has appeared as an Advocate and argued the
matter/case, as required under Rule 4(viii) of the Rules, 2025.
5.Applicants whose principal place of practice is other than the High
Court of Gujarat may be required to furnish such
information as may be called for by the Secretariat in terms of Rule
4(ix) of the Rules, 2025.
additional
The application shall be submitted to the Permanent Secretariat
(Adrnn. Dept. 'C' Branch) latest by 04:30 p.m. on 14.08.2026.

(Sunil B. Lodha)
